declarations.docstring: A submodule of a symmetric power preserved by every linear equivalence is either bottom or top.
Associates a scalar to a coefficient function and an auxiliary object parameterized by finite data.
The scalar assigned to the displayed finite-map input is the product of the coefficients selected by that map.
A linear map that scales each basis vector by a prescribed coefficient scales the displayed auxiliary term by their product.
Any submodule of a symmetric power stable under all linear equivalences is trivial or the whole space.
Auxiliary elements determined by finite maps agree when their lists of values are permutations.
